g.text: S03-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
Read-only transaction for this HTTP request
[target user active and target system enabled]
Also load inheritance edges, enabled permissions and role grants.
Collect grants and follow enabled junior roles.
Skip disabled roles, deduplicate permission IDs and preserve distinct source paths.
The transaction bypasses cache reads and writes.
Separate invocation: snapshot() outside a transaction
Look up the versioned key in L1, then Redis on miss.
Calculate from the database when neither cache yields a usable snapshot.
Write L1 and attempt to write Redis.
A version change before or after writing retries the attempt.
An unchanged version after writing ends the loop.
